caption: A spoonful of solid white coconut oil is dropped into a hot frying pan, and it melts into clear liquid.

sa.check: A spoonful of white solid coconut oil is dropped into the pan.
The melted oil is clear liquid.
A clear pool spreads out around the shrinking lump.
The order is white lump, melting, clear pool.

pc.expect: The lump only shrinks while the clear pool grows; it does not firm up again in the pan.
pc.fail: The lump regains the shape it was spooned in; or the pool draws back into the lump; or the oil sets white and solid again in the pan; or the lump alternates between larger and smaller.

pc.expect: The change from white to clear happens in the oil where it melts, starting at the pan, and the clear pool stays clear.
pc.fail: The clear pool turns white again while the pan is hot; or the lump melts into a liquid that stays milky; or the pan's surface changes colour rather than the oil; or the lump turns clear before it has begun to melt.

pc.expect: The pool spreads outward and downhill over the pan's floor and runs to its low side.
pc.fail: The pool climbs the pan's wall and stays; or a run of oil travels uphill; or oil lifts off the pan and floats; or the pool gathers above the lump.

pc.expect: The lump melts where it touches the metal: it goes clear and glossy underneath and the pool spreads from beneath it.
pc.fail: The lump melts from its top while its underside stays white and matt; or a pool spreads on a part of the pan the lump never touched; or the lump shrinks while the pan around it stays dry.

pc.expect: One spoonful of oil; the oil goes only from the lump into the pool.
pc.fail: The lump grows; or a second lump appears; or the lump vanishes while still large; or oil appears across the pan with none flowing there.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The pan's finish, the spoon and the hob stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or the spoon changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: Browning or foaming of the oil is chemistry and is not judged; the caption's point is that the melt is clear rather than white.
